headline: India's Renewables Save $100 Billion in Fuel Imports, IEA Reports
summary: India's clean energy growth has saved $100 billion in fuel imports, according to a new report from the International Energy Agency.
why: The International Energy Agency provides policy recommendations, analysis, and data on the global energy sector, tracking transitions to clean energy.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Significant reductions in fuel import costs affect the country's macroeconomic trade balance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
